controls.columns_shuffled: always (engines see canonical column order: sorted by value hash)

orientation_rule: not applicable (claims scored one by one)

metric_defs.ece: expected calibration error of calibrated claim probabilities (10 equal-width bins)
metric_defs.precision_at_half_coverage: DV-1 precision of the claims kept in order of calibrated probability until half of all target-outcome pairs are covered
metric_defs.realised_minus_claimed: realised precision minus mean claimed probability at threshold c/(g+c), c/g = 1, 2, 4
